author: Bethesda Softworks
description:
Season Zero: Dawn and Dusk is now live until July 8, 2026! Venture into the Night Market*, ESO’s first ever event zone, enjoy new ways to earn in-game rewards with the Gold Coast Bazaar and Tamriel Tomes, and experience a host of player-friendly base-game improvements. Welcome to a new age for The Elder Scrolls Online! *Night Market opens April 29. 

Official Site: https://www.elderscrollsonline.com
Facebook: http://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/elderscrollsonline.com
Twitter: https://twitter.com/TESOnline
Instagram: https://instagram.com/elderscrollsonline

ESRB Rating: MATURE with Blood and Gore, Sexual Themes, Use of Alcohol, and Violence. Online interactions not rated by the ESRB.
title: The Elder Scrolls Online – Season Zero

author: Bethesda Softworks
description:
For all the true collectors, a limited number of Colony War Action Figures will be available to bring home in the real world, coming later this year. Pre-order your Commander Sarah Morgan, Terrormorph, and UC Marine figures today at gear.bethesda.net! 

Plus, get ready to scour the galaxy for the new Colony War Action Figures in-game and the unique bonuses that come with them when the Free Lanes Update launches on April 7 alongside the arrival of Starfield on Playstation 5®.

Pre-Order here:
US Gear Store: https://gear.bethesda.net/collections/starfield-action-figures
International Gear Store: https://international.gear.bethesda.net/collections/starfield-action-figures

Learn more at https://bethesda.net/game/starfield/article/4nseLlnVaVc5sOVrzQZjAu/starfield-colony-war-action-figures-coming-soon
